title: Pager: recommendation-service p95 and memory both off baseline
symptoms: occasional allocation failures or container restarts late in the incident
latency growing in step with memory, not with a sudden traffic spike
increase in 5xx responses seen by callers
timeouts that could be mistaken for a slow dependency
RSS well above the usual band for that service
observed_signals: CPU increased only moderately until GC became frequent
GC pause time and heap-used warnings increased with memory
after a restart, memory dropped and then began climbing again
memory_usage rose smoothly over a long period rather than in a single jump

timeline.event: memory_usage on recommendation-service began a near-linear climb
GC / heap warnings became frequent on recommendation-service
restart or rollback dropped RSS; latency followed

contributing_factors: a library upgrade retained event listeners
no SLO existed on RSS slope
resolution: rolled back the library version that retained listeners
captured a heap dump before the second restart
added a slow memory-growth monitor (15-minute slope)
lessons_learned: heap dumps need to be taken before the second crash
a restart that restores latency is mitigation, not a fix
